title: How the sensing concept works
lead: The proposed chain runs from illumination to optical response, detection and interpretation.
description: Each stage has assumptions that need testing before the system can be treated as an integrated device.

sections.title: From sample to signal
paragraphs: Visible or infrared light could interact with a sample. A detector would capture a response for comparison with references; illumination geometry, noise and sample variability matter.

sections.title: Processing is a separate proposal
paragraphs: A reprogrammable analog neuromorphic processor appears in the described architecture as a possible interpretation component. It is distinct from AIFIELD’s neural field research.

sections.title: Integration questions
paragraphs: Calibration, optical packaging, electronics, software and connectivity all influence whether a laboratory idea can work in an intended form factor. Their combined performance is not yet established.
